records.text: Frank Turek said Michael McCoy and Catherine Castro, whom he described as a TPUSA team member, arranged for JD Vance to take Charlie Kirk's body back to Phoenix from Salt Lake City.
records.speaker: Frank Turek

appearances.snippet: We all had to go from Orem where we were, you and I were just last week, we all had to go from there to Salt Lake City because Mikey (Michael McCoy) and Catherine Castro, also a great team member of TPUSA, arranged for J.D. Vance (JD Vance) to come and take Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s body back to Phoenix.
